question: GLEASON24-Q8

search_ground_truth.source: Full live Materials Project response independently captured by the evaluation harness, pinned to database version and timestamp.
search_ground_truth.predicate: Cu-containing, non-deprecated, (is_stable is True OR theoretical is False), and not in the valid seed-ID set.
search_ground_truth.completeness: Check query scope and pagination against the harness capture. A list of self-reported selected IDs does not establish search completeness.
search_ground_truth.id_changes: Check reported aliases/deprecations; the candidate must not silently reinterpret unresolved seed IDs as novel materials.
search_ground_truth.historical_count: Do not require exactly 2,175 IDs or the paper figure counts from today’s database.

simulation_ground_truth.budget: Exactly three eligible materials, with single-site and multiple-site Cu environments represented when available.
simulation_ground_truth.setup: Independently check crystal structure, equivalent Cu groups, multiplicity weights, L2/L3 job coverage and declared FEFF settings.
simulation_ground_truth.fresh_execution: Require a benchmark-managed FEFF execution trace, convergence checks and raw output files. Candidate-authored logs alone are not proof of computation.
simulation_ground_truth.archived_references: Use reference_cases.json and the site/material CSVs only after checking that the structures, absorber environments, settings and energy conventions agree.
simulation_ground_truth.new_or_changed_inputs: Generate independent evaluator FEFF references from the pinned current structures. Do not grade new structures against unrelated archived curves.
simulation_ground_truth.failure_handling: Record incomplete/failed calculations and missing multiplicity coverage. Do not declare a complete three-material answer by silently omitting failed sites.
simulation_ground_truth.comparison: Assess energy axes, edge features, relative intensities, material averaging and contribution plots. No numerical FEFF threshold is claimed as calibrated before the fresh-run pilot.

input_boundary: Only seed IDs, simulation settings, necessary scientific background, live MP access and the runtime FEFF installation go to the agent. Keep reference_cases, archived spectra, runtime audit, candidate code and setup-check fixtures on the evaluator side.
